palette.rule: One neutral scale carries every surface and line; four hues carry meaning. Hue is never used decoratively.

colors.graphite: the neutral scale — surfaces, lines, text (#0f1216 → #3d4956, text #828d9c → #e7ecf2)
colors.amber: primary accent and the Model A series — #e2a13f
colors.green: healthy state — fresh data, an axis the leading model wins — #4fb286
colors.red: error state — a failed source, a regression — #e2685f

palette.effort_chips: Ordinal data gets an ordinal ramp: all five effort levels are the same amber at increasing intensity, not five different hues.
palette.background: Deliberately not near-black and not a coloured gradient: #0f1216 with a neutral-to-neutral 180deg wash (#151b23 → #0f1216) so surfaces read as top-lit rather than flat.

contrast.method: browser-measured (probe/verify-ui.mjs) in Chrome at 1280x900 and 320-844px viewports
contrast.floor: 4.5:1 (WCAG AA) for all text tiers, including --text-faint
